title: Spicy Almond Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir-fry with spicy sauce and crunchy almonds. This dish is inspired by Indian cuisine and can be served as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chili peppers and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the bamboo shoots and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced almonds and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until they are lightly toasted.
Stir in the eamatriciana sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stir-fry hot, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
